subject: Notice: change to processing location / request to confirm audit scope & DPIA support
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Price <dprice@gatebank.com>, Olivia Stern <olivia.stern@finsecure.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Notice: change to processing location / request to confirm audit scope & DPIA support

Hi Daniel / Olivia,

Quick heads-up: we plan to route a subset of GateBank production inference workload (customer-facing embeddings & reranking) to our EU processing cluster (Frankfurt) starting 2028-09-01 for improved latency for EU users. This is a configuration change only — model artifacts and PII-none metadata will remain under the terms of the DPA — but I wanted to surface it early because we know your security / privacy team will want:

- confirmation of the updated subprocessors list and locations
- an updated Art. 30 processing register excerpt reflecting the EU cluster
- a proposed window for a scoped audit or evidence review (ideally 2-3 weeks before the cutover)
- support for your DPIA team (we can provide artifacts and an ops walk-through)

Can you confirm the required audit scope (controls / timeframe) and whether the standard GateBank checklist needs extra artifacts (e.g., network topology, KMS proof-of-rotation logs)? I copied Marissa from our compliance team — she can assemble the packet.

Attachments I will have ready for your review: redwood_subprocessors_2028-08.csv (subprocessor names + regions), DPA_addendum_GATEBANK_v2.docx (simple addendum for processing location), and an Art. 30 register excerpt. I can also share a short Drive folder with the DPIA support docs.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can GateBank confirm audit scope by EOD Aug 11?
2) If yes, Marissa will schedule a 60-minute technical walk-through during the audit window.
3) We’ll prepare the evidence bundle at least one week prior to the walk-through.

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if easier.

Best,

--
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0137
Redwood Inference

From: Daniel Price <dprice@gatebank.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Stern <olivia.stern@finsecure.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: change to processing location / request to confirm audit scope & DPIA support

Aisha — thanks for the heads-up. A few clarifying Qs from our side before I confirm scope: 

1) What types of data will be processed in the EU cluster? You mentioned "PII-none metadata" — we need exact class labels so our DPIA team can map risk.
2) Can you confirm whether any subprocessor in the EU cluster is a downstream contractor (i.e., will Redwood engage any third-party caching/CDN/observability vendors in that region)? If so, we will need contracts + SCCs.
3) For the audit window: GateBank prefers evidence 7 business days prior to any cutover. The scope we typically ask for: environment inventory, subprocessor attestations, sample network diagrams, KMS key policy snapshot (read-only), and an extract from your access control logs for the last 30 days. Is that feasible?

Also: we may need a short addendum to the DPA acknowledging the change in processing location (our legal team wants explicit language). If your DPA_addendum_GATEBANK_v2.docx is a draft, please mark the change lines for quick redlines.

If convenient, Olivia and I can take a 30-minute call tomorrow afternoon to go over specifics.

Thanks,
Daniel

--
Daniel Price
Senior Privacy Counsel, GateBank
dprice@gatebank.com | +44 20 7946 0800

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Price <dprice@gatebank.com>, Olivia Stern <olivia.stern@finsecure.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Aug 2028 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: change to processing location / request to confirm audit scope & DPIA support

Hi Daniel / Olivia — thanks, noted. Quick answers and an operational proposal below.

Data class: the workloads targeted are model inference requests for embeddings and reranking. No authenticated PII fields are stored by Redwood. We persist ephemeral request/response traces for debugging (retention 7 days) and a small set of non-identifying metadata (e.g., request region, model_variant). I have attached an "art30_register_excerpt.pdf" that shows the processing purpose and categories.

Subprocessors: the CSV lists all active subprocessors and region tags. For the EU cluster specifically, there is one downstream caching provider (CacheFast EU Ltd.) that we use for short-lived KV caching; its contract is covered under our subprocessor regime and SCCs are already in place. If you like, we can produce a signed attestation from CacheFast.

Audit window & artifacts: we can provide the items you requested. Proposed timeline:
- Aug 15: GateBank confirms final scope (you asked EOD Aug 11 — we can extend to Aug 15 to accommodate legal).
- Aug 20: Redwood uploads evidence bundle to the shared Drive folder (link below).
- Aug 22–24: Onsite / remote walkthrough (60–90 mins) with our infra+security engineers.

Artifacts we will include in the bundle:
- environment_inventory.csv (hostnames, regions, roles)
- subprocessor_contracts_summary.pdf (signed SCCs highlighted)
- kms_policy_snapshot.txt (read-only snapshot)
- access_control_sample.log (redacted)
- art30_register_excerpt.pdf

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-GateBank-DPIA
HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/record/DEAL-78910

DPA addendum: DPA_addendum_GATEBANK_v2.docx is attached — it’s a short addendum that calls out the additional processing location and confirms that obligations / security controls are unchanged. We’ve flagged the exact wording for quick redlines.

Next step: Please confirm the scope by Aug 15 and whether you want the CacheFast attestation included in the bundle. If you want a quick call, I’m available Aug 10 at 09:00–11:00 PT.

Regards,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0288

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Price <dprice@gatebank.com>, Olivia Stern <olivia.stern@finsecure.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Notice: change to processing location / request to confirm audit scope & DPIA support

Daniel / Olivia — Jonas here (Head of Solutions). Appreciated — wanted to add operational commitments so you have comfort on SLAs and rollback: 

- Rollback: if any control gaps are identified during the review we will hold the cutover until remediations are verified; we will not flip production without written sign-off from GateBank security.
- Monitoring: we will enable extra telemetry for GateBank traffic for the two-week post-cutover window and share an aggregated latency/cost report.
- Access: only named engineers on the evidence invite will be given read-only access to the Drive bundle; no admin keys will be shared.

If that aligns with GateBank’s requirements, please confirm scope and we’ll lock the dates.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
